##### Project general facts

Bugatti Residences by Binghatti is an ultra-luxury residential development located in Business Bay, defined by its iconic architectural identity and collaboration with the renowned Bugatti brand. The tower features a flowing, wave-inspired façade influenced by the elegance of the French Riviera, combined with signature design elements that create a bold and recognizable presence within the Dubai skyline. Comprising multiple levels including an exclusive collection of residences and penthouses, the project offers spacious two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments, all designed with expansive layouts, panoramic views, and a seamless integration of indoor and outdoor living.

Residents benefit from a curated selection of world-class amenities designed to deliver a resort-style living experience. The development includes a private beach, swimming pools, a luxury spa, wellness club, and a state-of-the-art gym with personal training services. Dedicated relaxation areas and event spaces further enhance the lifestyle offering, creating an environment that combines leisure, exclusivity, and comfort at the highest level.

Interiors are finished with exceptional attention to detail, featuring premium materials and refined design elements that reflect the project’s ultra-luxury positioning. Residences include equipped kitchens, along with private pools, jacuzzis, and maid’s rooms, ensuring both functionality and exclusivity. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their interiors while benefiting from bespoke finishes and a highly sophisticated architectural concept.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and prestigious districts, positioned alongside the iconic Dubai Canal and just minutes from Downtown Dubai. Known for its striking skyline of contemporary towers, the area blends residential, commercial, and hospitality developments, creating a vibrant urban environment. Its central location ensures seamless connectivity to key destinations such as Sheikh Zayed Road, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, making it a highly desirable address for both living and investment.

The district offers a well-rounded lifestyle supported by a wide range of amenities and attractions. Residents enjoy access to waterfront promenades, fine dining restaurants, stylish cafés, retail outlets, and luxury hotels, all within walking distance. Fitness centers, wellness spaces, and landscaped public areas further enhance everyday living, while the Dubai Canal adds a scenic and tranquil element to the fast-paced city setting.

Business Bay is also known for its strong investment appeal, driven by high rental demand and continuous development. The area attracts professionals, entrepreneurs, and international residents seeking a modern, connected lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. With its combination of convenience, lifestyle offerings, and architectural presence, Business Bay stands as one of the city’s most sought-after urban destinations.
